claims.evidence: No legible brand/model marking visible; ID plate text on valve cover is unreadable, and no overall shot confirms all accessories (turbo, injectors, alternator, starter) are present.
Origin and import history cannot be seen in any photo; no shipping/customs documentation shown.
No video or audio of the engine running; photos only show a static, mounted block. This also conflicts with the seller's own '(parts)' label.
No hour meter or usage log visible in either photo.
Valve cover is bolted on and tools rest on top, but no close-up proves seals are factory-intact or untouched.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal faults (knock, low compression)
risks.proof: A clear video clip of the engine starting, idling, and running under light load with audible sound.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (turbo, injectors, alternator, starter)
risks.proof: Full 360° photos showing all sides of the engine with accessories clearly visible and labeled.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare block only, missing major components

risks.proof: A clear, legible close-up photo of the ID/serial plate matching Caterpillar C9 specifications.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified industrial diesel engine

risks.risk: Unknown true usage/hours despite 'low mileage' claim
risks.proof: Photo of hour meter reading or maintenance log with dates and hours.

risks.risk: Possible internal wear or leaks not visible externally
risks.proof: Oil pressure/compression test report or video of fluid checks.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming need for full inspection/rebuild

risks.risk: Origin/import claim (Tokunbo ex-Belgium) unverifiable, affects trust and valuation
risks.proof: Import/customs documents or bill of lading matching the engine's serial number.

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of the ID/serial plate showing full legible text (brand, model, serial number).
Video of the engine starting and running, with audible sound, no cuts.
Photos from all sides showing presence/absence of turbocharger, injectors, alternator, starter, and wiring completeness.
Hour meter photo or service/maintenance record.
Any import/customs paperwork supporting the 'Tokunbo from Belgium' claim.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an industrial diesel engine, but running condition, completeness, and identity (C9 model) are all unconfirmed by the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly incomplete, non-running engine pending the listed proofs.
